name: gesture-detector
description: Standalone webcam hand-gesture detector (MediaPipe Hand Landmarker) for a Pac-Man web game

scripts.setup:local: mkdir -p assets/wasm assets/models && cp node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/vision_bundle.mjs assets/ && cp node_modules/@mediapipe/tasks-vision/wasm/* assets/wasm/ && curl -L -o assets/models/hand_landmarker.task https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/hand_landmarker/hand_landmarker/float16/1/hand_landmarker.task
scripts.check: node --check js/camera.js && node --check js/handTracker.js && node --check js/gestureClassifier.js && node --check js/gestureStability.js && node --check js/gestureController.js && node --check js/main.js
